entities.name: EKS Meta Manager
entities.rationale: Icon at (674,237) labeled EKS, with 'F.E' and 'META MANAGER' text; sits inside a small blue rectangle. Microservices-based Meta Manager (brains of the grid) and frontend run on EKS.

entities.name: ElasticSearch / Neo4J MetaStore
entities.rationale: Icon at (675,420) labeled 'ELASTIC SEARCH NEO4J'. MetaStore combining document and graph database, storing metadata discovered by Meta Manager.

entities.name: S3 Data Lake
entities.rationale: Icon at (985,268) labeled 'S3 DATA LAKE', annotated 60tb. Inside the blue dashed container together with Kafka and EMR.

entities.name: Kafka
entities.rationale: Icon at (914,467) labeled 'KAFKA', annotated 600 topics. Inside the blue dashed container with S3 and EMR; enterprise streaming platform.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: Icon at (1079,468) labeled 'EMR'. Inside the blue dashed container with S3 and Kafka; used to bring data into the data lake.

entities.name: RDS
entities.rationale: Icon at (1299,305) labeled 'RDS', outside to the right of the dashed container; data store for consumption.

entities.name: Vertica
entities.rationale: Icon at (1295,486) is an EC2 icon labeled 'VERTICA'; Vertica analytics database hosted on EC2, right of the dashed container.

entities.name: Multiple Data Sources
entities.rationale: Database icon at (851,713) labeled 'MULTIPLE DATA SOURCES', below the green dashed line (outside the platform); external/on-prem sources across networks and countries.

entities.name: Applications
entities.rationale: Puzzle icon at (1077,714) labeled 'APPLICATIONS', below the green dashed line; business applications/APIs that produce and consume data.

entities.name: DA/DS
entities.rationale: User icon at (1293,715) labeled 'DA/DS' (data analysts / data scientists), below the green dashed line; consume data for analytics and models.

visual_connections.description: Pink arrow coming from the top-left down and into the F.E side of the EKS box; frontend/users connect to the Meta Manager.

Pair of pink up/down arrows crossing the green dashed line between Multiple Data Sources and Kafka.
Pair of pink up/down arrows crossing the green dashed line between Applications and EMR.
Pink arrows on the left side of S3, one going up into S3 and one going down toward Kafka.
Pink arrows on the right side of S3, one going down toward EMR and one going up back into S3.
Pink arrow from the right edge of the dashed data lake container to RDS.
Pink arrow from the right edge of the dashed container (at EMR height) to Vertica on EC2.
